cast_syntax: /cast player-1 enhance-ability player-1 --ability STR | /cast player-1 enhance-ability --targets player-1,ally-id --target-abilities player-1:STR,ally-id:DEX --slot-level 3
notes: Exact XPHB Enhance Ability grants advantage on checks using the chosen ability, with per-target ability choices on higher-slot casts.
